sections.name: Courtyard canal gardens
sections.motion: Water flows with visible illustrated ripples through the whole canal around the bridge and rocks. All complete reed clusters along both banks sway gently together, and the complete palm above the west bank softly sways its leaves from its fixed trunk. Crop-edge objects remain stationary. The bridge, posts, banks, garden walls, crops and rocks remain precisely fixed.
sections.assessment: Visible canal ripple and reed motion; small endpoint mismatch; cropped upper temple decorations preserved from static map.

sections.name: Sanctuary altar and lamps
sections.motion: Both wall-lamp flames flicker naturally with restrained warm local glow. The complete blue cloth banners beside the altar gently stir from fixed top attachments. Complete potted plants near the altar have a soft breeze in their leaves. The water in the central offering bowl has faint illustrated ripples. Walls, columns, furniture, pots, bowl, altar steps, trunks, floor and sun emblem remain precisely fixed. Objects cut by the crop edge remain entirely stationary. No global brightness pulsing.
sections.assessment: Visible flames, banners, plant leaves and bowl ripples; small endpoint mismatch; fixed architecture remains aligned.
